senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. m. Naboth, a citizen of Jezreel.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 102b:15">Snh. 102ᵇ</cite>, a. e. (ref. to <cite ref="I Kings 22:22">I Kings XXII, 22</cite>) <he>רוחו של נ׳</he> the spirit of (the murdered) Naboth.

<cite ref="Shevuot 35b:9-12">Shebu. 35ᵇ</cite> <he>כל שמות … בנ׳ וכ׳</he> all the names (Elohim) mentioned in connection with Naboth (<cite ref="I Kings 21:10">I Kings XXI, 10</cite>; <cite ref="I Kings 21:13">13</cite>) are sacred (meaning God).
